name: Pikachu
hints: Electric Type Mouse Pokémon
Yellow body with red cheek pouches that store electricity
Signature mascot of the Pokémon franchise that evolves into Raichu

name: Charmander
hints: Fire Type Lizard Pokémon
Orange body with a cream-colored belly and blue eyes
The flame at the tip of its tail indicates its health and emotions

name: Charizard
hints: Fire and Flying Type Flame Pokémon
Large orange dragon-like creature with massive wings and fiery breath
The final evolution of the Gen 1 fire starter Charmander

name: Bulbasaur
hints: Grass and Poison Type Seed Pokémon
Green quadruped with dark green spots and red eyes
Carries a large plant bulb on its back from the day it is born

name: Squirtle
hints: Water Type Tiny Turtle Pokémon
Light blue body with a tough brown shell and curly tail
Shoots water from its mouth and leader of a famous anime squad with sunglasses

name: Blastoise
hints: Water Type Shellfish Pokémon
Large bipedal blue turtle with a heavy brown shell
Features two powerful pressurized water cannons protruding from its shell

name: Gengar
hints: Ghost and Poison Type Shadow Pokémon
Round purple body with glowing red eyes and a mischievous sinister grin
Hides in the shadows of people and absorbs warmth from its surroundings

name: Mewtwo
hints: Psychic Type Genetic Pokémon
Bipedal feline humanoid with a purple tail and immense telekinetic power
Created by scientists through gene splicing from Mew's DNA

name: Mew
hints: Psychic Type New Species Pokémon
Small pink mythical creature with blue eyes and a long thin tail
Said to possess the genetic code of all existing Pokémon and can learn any TM

name: Eevee
hints: Normal Type Evolution Pokémon
Small brown mammalian creature with a bushy tail and cream-colored neck ruff
Has an unstable genetic makeup allowing it to evolve into eight different forms

name: Snorlax
hints: Normal Type Sleeping Pokémon
Huge dark blue-green creature with a cream belly and closed eyes
Spends almost all its time eating and sleeping, often blocking routes until a Poké Flute is played

name: Jigglypuff
hints: Normal and Fairy Type Balloon Pokémon
Round pink ball with large blue eyes, cat-like ears, and a curl of fur
Sings a soothing lullaby that puts listeners to sleep, then draws on their faces with a marker

name: Gyarados
hints: Water and Flying Type Atrocious Pokémon
Enormous serpentine sea monster with blue scales and an gaping mouth
Known for destructive rages and surprisingly evolves from the helpless Magikarp

name: Magikarp
hints: Water Type Fish Pokémon
Orange fish with a yellow crown fin, large barbels, and blank eyes
Famous for being virtually useless in battle using only Splash before evolving

name: Dragonite
hints: Dragon and Flying Type Dragon Pokémon
Friendly-looking orange bipedal dragon with small wings and kind green eyes
Capable of circling the globe in just 16 hours and rescues drowning sailors

name: Psyduck
hints: Water Type Duck Pokémon
Yellow duck-like creature that constantly clutches its head with both hands
Suffers from chronic headaches that unleash powerful psychic abilities when severe

name: Meowth
hints: Normal Type Scratch Cat Pokémon
Small cream-colored feline with brown tipped ears and curled tail
Has a shiny golden koban coin on its forehead and is famous for talking in Team Rocket

name: Alakazam
hints: Psychic Type Psi Pokémon
Yellow humanoid with long mustache whiskers and an IQ exceeding 5,000
Holds two silver spoons that amplify its telekinetic brainwaves

name: Machamp
hints: Fighting Type Superpower Pokémon
Muscular gray bipedal warrior wearing a champion belt
Has four muscular arms capable of unleashing a flurry of 1,000 punches in two seconds

name: Onix
hints: Rock and Ground Type Rock Snake Pokémon
Massive chain of gray boulders that forms a giant burrowing serpent
Tunneling underground at 50 mph, it is Brock's signature Pokémon

name: Lapras
hints: Water and Ice Type Transport Pokémon
Gentle blue sea creature with a knobby gray shell and curly ears
Ferry across oceans with people riding on its back, known for singing beautiful songs

name: Ditto
hints: Normal Type Transform Pokémon
Malleable pink-purple blob with beady black eyes and a simple smile
Can perfectly reorganize its cellular structure to transform into any other Pokémon

name: Vaporeon
hints: Water Type Bubble Jet Pokémon
Blue quadruped with a white neck ruff and a mermaid-like fin tail
Its cellular structure is similar to water, allowing it to melt invisibly into water

name: Jolteon
hints: Electric Type Lightning Pokémon
Yellow quadruped with spiky white neck collar and needle-like electrified fur
Generates electricity from negative ions in its fur, evolving from Eevee via Thunder Stone

name: Flareon
hints: Fire Type Flame Pokémon
Reddish-orange quadruped with a fluffy yellow mane and bushy tail
Has a flame sac inside its body that can superheat inhaled air up to 3,000 degrees

name: Lucario
hints: Fighting and Steel Type Aura Pokémon
Bipedal canine with blue and black fur and metal spikes on paws and chest
Can read and manipulate the aura energy of all living beings

name: Greninja
hints: Water and Dark Type Ninja Pokémon
Dark blue frog-like creature that wraps its long pink tongue around its neck like a scarf
Creates throwing stars out of compressed water and is Ash's famous Kalos ace

name: Garchomp
hints: Dragon and Ground Type Mach Pokémon
Dark blue hammerhead land shark with red chest and scythe-like fin arms
Flies at the speed of a jet fighter and is Champion Cynthia's feared ace Pokémon

name: Togepi
hints: Fairy Type Spike Ball Pokémon
Tiny creature encased inside an eggshell with red and blue triangular markings
Said to store happiness in its shell and share it with kind-hearted people

name: Rayquaza
hints: Dragon and Flying Type Sky High Pokémon
Colossal green serpentine dragon with yellow ring patterns and aerodynamic fins
Lives high in the ozone layer for hundreds of millions of years, calming Kyogre and Groudon
